plugins.name: codebase-wiki
plugins.description: Karpathy-style docs/index.md wiki for any codebase — progressive disclosure for LLM agents. Provides /doc-init, /doc-update, /doc-audit commands.

plugins.name: convex-app-setup
plugins.description: Consultative setup guidance for Convex applications across web and mobile surfaces.

plugins.name: design-first
plugins.description: A bounded visual direction gate that separates mockup approval from production UI implementation and validation.

plugins.name: mobile-visual-validation
plugins.description: Validate mobile visuals, run Expo builds on a shared workstation, and build reproducible localized Store screenshots or vertical app showcase videos from real captures.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: A selective adapter for pstack's writing, architecture, workflow, and engineering-principle skills.

plugins.name: ux-writing-audit
plugins.description: Audit product interface copy for clarity, consistency, voice, actionability, and localization readiness.

plugins.name: engineering-quality
plugins.description: Focused engineering skills for maintainability, strict TypeScript, coverage risk, characterization tests, and flaky-test diagnosis.

plugins.name: engineering-architecture
plugins.description: A focused architecture pack for technical specifications and STRIDE threat models.

plugins.name: cli-for-agent
plugins.description: Patterns for designing CLIs that coding agents can run reliably: non-interactive flags, layered help with examples, pipelines, actionable errors, idempotency, and dry-run.

plugins.name: marketplace-authoring
plugins.description: Centralize Codex and Claude skills in the Suarja marketplace with correct plugin routing, manifests, provenance, validation, publication, and cache refresh.

plugins.name: relay-ops
plugins.description: Reusable editorial and human-reviewed publication workflows for a social control plane.

plugins.name: generated-visual-assets
plugins.description: Produce a coherent series of AI-generated illustrations for a product, reproducibly, and give them short motion clips that do not destroy them.
